rate_offered.notes: Printed '(2.00%)P-2.75%' in the offered nominal rate; rate type 'משתנה', linkage 'לא צמוד'; adjusted '2.0000%', common 'P-4.5%'; exit points 'כל חודש'; break 'אין אפשרות שבירה'; renewal 'לא מתחדש'. Read 2026-11-14 from the data the page loads (https://apps.fibi.co.il/bff-depositmanagement/api/v1/fibi/depositDetails/31, 'effectiveDate' 2026-11-15, 'prime' 4.75); the 447 row is in the family 'פיקדונות בהוראת קבע' (standing-order deposits). Account type 286, product 463. The read of 2026-11-07 ('effectiveDate' 2026-11-08) printed '(0.25%)P-4.5%', adjusted '0.2500%', common 'P-4.5%': the offered rate rose by 1.75 points while the common-deposit column kept P-4.5%. The common-deposit column ('שיעור הריבית לפיקדון שכיח') is, in the rule base's glossary of bank-current-account-deposits, the rate actually common where the published minimum applies to few deposits, not the rate offered, so the two may differ; the table does not say whether the new rate is for new plans only. The offered rate is recorded; the doubt is in doubt_he.
